# Screens the scenarios recognise, one per line:
#
#   <name> <WxH+X+Y> grid <cell> <tolerance> <mean grey of each cell, hex>
#   <name> <WxH+X+Y> mask <bright pixels> <dark pixels>
#
# A grid screen matches when the mean grey of each cell x cell square of the
# area differs from the signature by at most <tolerance> on average (0 to
# 255). A mask screen is text over any background: it matches when at least
# 80% of the text's bright pixels are bright and 80% of its dark outline is
# dark (each pixel set is a bit mask over the area, row by row). Signatures
# come from screenshots of the original exe:
#
#   uv run tools/playtest.py --signature NAME SCREENSHOT.png WxH+X+Y [--mask]
#   uv run tools/playtest.py --match SCREENSHOT.png...
